drivingQuestion: May bird meat be placed on the same table as cheese, and on which table does the ruling bear?
outcomeNote: A mishna recording a dispute between the houses with R' Yosei's classification and a scope qualification; nothing is argued out or decided here.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָעוֹף עוֹלֶה עִם הַגְּבִינָה עַל הַשּׁוּלְחָן, וְאֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל, דִּבְרֵי בֵּית שַׁמַּאי. וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים: לֹא עוֹלֶה וְלֹא נֶאֱכָל. אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: זוֹ מִקּוּלֵּי בֵּית שַׁמַּאי וּמֵחוּמְרֵי בֵּית הִלֵּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The» meat of «birds may be placed with cheese on» one «table but» may «not be eaten» together with it; this is «the statement of Beit Shammai. And Beit Hillel say:» It may «neither be placed» on one table «nor be eaten» with cheese. «Rabbi Yosei said: This is» one «of the» disputes involving «leniencies of Beit Shammai and stringencies of Beit Hillel.»

segments.he: בְּאֵיזֶה שׁוּלְחָן אָמְרוּ? בְּשׁוּלְחָן שֶׁאוֹכֵל עָלָיו, אֲבָל בְּשׁוּלְחָן שֶׁסּוֹדֵר עָלָיו אֶת הַתַּבְשִׁיל – נוֹתֵן זֶה בְּצַד זֶה, וְאֵינוֹ חוֹשֵׁשׁ.
segments.en: The mishna elaborates: «With regard to which table» are these halakhot «stated?» It is «with regard to a table upon which one eats. But on a table upon which one prepares the cooked food, one» may «place this» meat «alongside that» cheese or vice versa, «and» need «not be concerned» that perhaps they will be mixed and one will come to eat them together.

moves.cueHe: העוף עולה עם הגבינה על השולחן, ואינו נאכל
moves.summary: Beit Shammai permit placing bird meat with cheese on one table while forbidding eating them together
moves.about: whether bird meat may be placed on the same table as cheese, granted that it may not be eaten with it

moves.cueHe: ובית הלל אומרים: לא עולה ולא נאכל
moves.summary: Beit Hillel forbid both placing and eating
moves.about: classifying this dispute between the houses as one of the anomalous cases in which Beit Shammai is the lenient side and Beit Hillel the stringent

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יוסי: זו מקולי בית שמאי ומחומרי בית הלל
moves.summary: R' Yosei classes the dispute among the cases where Beit Shammai is lenient and Beit Hillel stringent
the mishna asks which table the ruling was said of
moves.about: the ban on placing bird meat with cheese applies only to the table one eats at, not to the table on which food is arranged before serving

moves.summary: answers that it is the table one eats at, not the one on which the food is arranged
